test_item:
OFF message has to be sent to all connected clients on boot or resume from suspend
(head unit resumes from suspend on Atl-Mi; disabling is notified)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Send the ignition signal on the Atl-Mi bus
Send CAN: BCM_FD_9.PowerModeSts = <raw> (<label>)
2. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. BCM_FD_9.PowerModeSts = <raw> (<label>) is sent
2. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the OFF notification to the target functions
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-SAM-0013 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: EE architecture
channel_feasible: N/N
CAN signal per VHAL User Guide R5 section 2.4; BCM_FD_9 is 0x42A; DBC lookup pending
